item.title: From Design to Code: Formally Analyzing Signal's Post-Quantum Ratchet
item.description: In 2025, Signal deployed the Sparse Post-Quantum Ratchet (SPQR) . It runs alongside the classic Double Ratchet and is designed so that conversations keep their forward secrecy and post-compromise security unless both elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman and ML-KEM are broken. At ACM CCS 2026 in The Hague this November, Rolfe Schmidt from Signal will present our joint paper with the formal specification and security analysis of SPQR. The analysis covers not only the design but also the Rust code that ships in Signal.
